title: Signal: Raw HTML sink (innerHTML) — review required
limitations: Lexical, line-based, no dataflow: any innerHTML assignment matches, including static safe markup. Reads (el.innerHTML) and strict === comparisons do not match. Framework sinks (jQuery .html(), React dangerouslySetInnerHTML) are out of scope.
